snippet.title: Body Hiding Simulator - Demo Gameplay
snippet.description:
Play as the happy housewife in a quiet home. Except tonight, your husband is hosting his noisy friends for a dinner party! Not so happy a housewife after all...

Your goal is to disrupt this party by eliminating all of your husbands guests, as quickly as possible. Set traps and create weapons to dispose of these annoying disturbances, but make sure your husband does not catch you in the act! You wouldn't want to disrupt your blissful marital life...
